name: Firmware e debug
description: Registri, interrupt, debug: il linguaggio del firmware.

terms.definition: A small memory location inside a peripheral that controls or reports its state.
terms.example: I read the status register after every transfer.
terms.note: Si legge «règister», con la g dolce e l'accento all'inizio.

terms.definition: A signal that stops the normal program to handle an event.
terms.example: The timer interrupt fires every millisecond.

terms.definition: Direct memory access: moving data without using the CPU.
terms.example: We use DMA to move the ADC samples to RAM.

terms.definition: A hardware block of the microcontroller, like a timer or a UART.
terms.example: We validated every peripheral on the new chip.

terms.definition: The small program that starts first and loads the main application.
terms.example: The bootloader checks the image before jumping to it.

terms.definition: A point where the debugger stops the program.
terms.example: Set a breakpoint in the interrupt handler.

terms.definition: A standard interface to test and debug chips.
terms.example: We connected to the core through JTAG.

terms.definition: Serial wire debug: a two-pin debug interface used on Arm chips.
terms.example: SWD needs only two pins: SWDIO and SWCLK.

terms.definition: A timer that resets the system if the software stops responding.
terms.example: The watchdog reset the MCU after the deadlock.

terms.definition: The memory area for function calls and local variables.
terms.example: We increased the stack size to two kilobytes.

terms.definition: The memory area for dynamic allocation.
terms.example: Avoid using the heap in interrupt handlers.

terms.definition: The file that tells the linker where to place code and data in memory.
terms.example: I changed the linker script to move the vectors to RAM.

terms.definition: The list of addresses used by memories and peripherals.
terms.example: The memory map is in chapter three of the reference manual.

terms.definition: How the clock signals are generated and distributed inside the chip.
terms.example: The PLL output feeds the whole clock tree.

terms.definition: Phase-locked loop: a circuit that multiplies a reference clock to a higher frequency.
terms.example: The PLL locks in less than one hundred microseconds.

terms.definition: A state where the chip turns off parts of itself to save energy.
terms.example: In the deepest low-power mode the current is one microamp.

terms.definition: An event that brings the chip out of a low-power mode.
terms.example: The RTC alarm is the wake-up source.

terms.definition: Non-volatile memory that keeps the program when the power is off.
terms.example: We erase the flash memory before programming.

terms.definition: The binary file that is programmed into the chip.
terms.example: The firmware image is signed by the build server.

terms.definition: The set of tools to build software: compiler, linker, debugger.
terms.example: We moved to a newer version of the toolchain.

terms.definition: The program that turns source code into machine code.
terms.example: The compiler optimized away my test loop!

terms.definition: When the stack grows beyond its memory area.
terms.example: The hard fault was caused by a stack overflow.

terms.definition: A severe CPU exception, for example after an illegal memory access.
terms.example: The firmware went into a hard fault after the DMA transfer.

terms.definition: A bug that appears only when two events happen in a certain order.
terms.example: It was a race condition between the ISR and the main loop.

terms.definition: When two tasks wait for each other forever.
terms.example: The two tasks were in a deadlock on the same mutex.

terms.definition: Checking a flag again and again instead of using an interrupt.
terms.example: We replaced polling with an interrupt to save power.

terms.definition: Interrupt service routine: the function that runs when an interrupt fires.
terms.example: Keep the ISR as short as possible.

terms.definition: Real-time operating system: it runs tasks with predictable timing.
terms.example: The application runs on an RTOS with five tasks.

terms.definition: The software that controls a peripheral.
terms.example: I wrote the SPI driver from scratch.

terms.definition: Hardware abstraction layer: a library that hides the register details.
terms.example: The HAL makes the code portable between chips.

terms.definition: A value used to select some bits of a register.
terms.example: Use a bit mask to clear only bit seven.

terms.definition: The order of bytes in a multi-byte value: little or big endian.
terms.example: The bug was an endianness problem in the protocol.
